units.source_text: 今上屡次向他隐约暗示此意。

en.t: The reigning emperor had hinted this intention to him several times.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言虽然非由传言而是直接承旨，

en.t: Although Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had not heard it through rumor but had received the emperor's wishes directly,

units.source_text: 但因向有古怪脾气，故并无立刻从命之意。

en.t: because he had always had an eccentric temperament, he had no intention of obeying at once.
He thought, "This is not what I truly want.

units.source_text: 多年来别人屡次把可爱的人儿推荐给我，我都巧妙地谢绝了。

en.t: For years, whenever people repeatedly recommended charming women to me, I managed to refuse them tactfully.

units.source_text: 现在倘当了驸马，正好比和尚还了俗。”

en.t: If I now become the emperor's son-in-law, it would be just like a monk returning to lay life."
This way of thinking was strange too.

units.source_text: 他明知有真心恋慕二公主而求之不得的人，

en.t: He knew perfectly well that there was someone who sincerely loved the Second Princess yet could not win her,

units.source_text: 心中却寻思：“倘是皇后生的，这才好呢。”

en.t: yet in his heart he mused, "If only she had been born of the empress, that would be ideal."
This was truly far too presumptuous.
